name: Revisit Past Pains
disable: DC 48 Diplomacy check (master) to calm the spirit or DC 46 Occultism check (master) to ward off the spirit

items.name: Share Pain
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area

---

Effect Creatures within 30 feet take 6d12+41 mental damage (DC 40 basic Will save) as they experience the spirit's death.

text: A spirit locked in memories of its death flies down the hall, forcing intruders to experience the agony of its death.
